brand.name: Taxxa
brand.identity: A government-backed platform that gamifies tax compliance through receipt lotteries.

gradients.hero_text: bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 via-teal-400 to-cyan-400

layout.container: container mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 lg:px-8 max-w-7xl

Hero.layout: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 items-center min-h-[90vh]

elements.headline: Gradient text 'Rewarding Compliance.' with animated typewriter effect.
elements.visual: Right side: 3D floating lottery ticket or coin composition (using CSS or Spline/R3F if available, otherwise high-quality image with floating animation).

LiveDemo.concept: A smartphone frame scanning a receipt.
LiveDemo.interaction: User clicks 'Scan' -> Camera overlay appears -> Green scan line moves down -> 'Success! You entered the draw' confetti pop.
LiveDemo.tech: Use framer-motion for the scan line and confetti.

StatsCounter.style: Large tabular numbers, monospaced font for the numbers.
StatsCounter.animation: CountUp effect starting from 0 to millions.

HowItWorks.style: Vertical timeline with glowing connecting line. Icons light up as you scroll.

effects.noise: Add a subtle noise texture overlay with opacity-5 pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50 mix-blend-overlay

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all iconography (e.g., Scan, Ticket, Building, TrendingUp).

instructions_to_main_agent: INITIALIZATION: Ensure 'tailwind.config.js' is configured with the colors and fonts specified above. If missing, create it.
FONTS: Use Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'Inter'. Add them via CSS import or Expo Font loader.
ANIMATION: Use 'framer-motion' for all entrance animations (fadeInUp) and the interactive demo.
Responsive: Design Mobile-First. Ensure the 'Live Demo' scales down to fit mobile screens.
Theme: Force DARK MODE. The app should feel premium and dark.
Component Structure: Create separate files for 'HeroSection', 'HowItWorks', 'LiveDemo', 'Stats', 'Footer'.
Tailwind: Use arbitrary values sparingly. Extend the theme in config instead.
Accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios (Emerald text on Slate 950 is accessible). Use aria-labels for the demo.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Component Reuse: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Export Conventions: Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...). Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).
